# IDEAS/RePEc

> > IDEAS/RePEc is a comprehensive bibliographic database and research classification system for economics literature, featuring the JEL (Journal of Economic Literature) taxonomy and integration with RePEc services including MPRA, RePEc Genealogy, and EconAcademics.

IDEAS serves as the primary discovery and indexing platform for economics research worldwide, providing access to millions of working papers, journal articles, books, and chapters. The platform uses the standardized JEL classification system to organize economic literature into hierarchical categories, enabling researchers to browse and discover publications across all fields of economics.

## Key Topics

- JEL Classification System
- Economics Research Database
- RePEc Services
- Bibliographic Index
- Economic Literature Taxonomy
- Research Classification Codes
- MyIDEAS Personal Services
- MPRA (Munich Personal RePEc Archive)
- RePEc Genealogy
- EconAcademics
- Portfolio Choice & Investment (G11)
- Financial Economics Research
- Working Papers & Publications
- Academic Bibliography Management
- Economics Research Discovery

## JEL Classification System

- [JEL Classification | IDEAS/RePEc](https://ideas.repec.org/JEL/): Browse economics research using JEL classification taxonomy system
- [JEL Classification | IDEAS/RePEc](https://ideas.repec.org/j/): JEL classification system for organizing economic literature categories
- [JEL Classification | IDEAS/RePEc](https://ideas.repec.org/JEL/G11.html): JEL G11: Portfolio choice and investment decisions research papers

## Research Publications

- [Innovative Approaches And Their Application In Measuring Business Performance](https://ideas.repec.org/a/aad/iseicj/v5y2017i0p178-183.html): Matrix model approach for business performance measurement by Horváthová
- [Institutional Quality, Trade Protection Policy and Macroeconomic Performance in Nigeria](https://ideas.repec.org/a/ags/afjecr/330368.html): ARDL study on institutional quality and trade policy in Nigeria economy
- [Techniques And Analysis Of Management Audits](https://ideas.repec.org/a/aad/iseicj/v5y2017i0p132-137.html): McKinsey 7S model application for management audit techniques by Gallo
